ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weapon_slug=VALUES(weapon_slug), seller_id=VALUES(seller_id), price=VALUES(price), mod_rank=VALUES(mod_rank), rerolls=VALUES(rerolls), mastery=VALUES(mastery), polarity=VALUES(polarity), attributes_json=VALUES(attributes_json), raw_item_json=VALUES(raw_item_json), created_at=VALUES(created_at), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at), seller_last_seen=VALUES(seller_last_seen), seller_status=VALUES(seller_status), active=VALUES(active), last_observed_at=VALUES(last_observed_at)
mapper.sql: active=1 AND last_observed_at >= #{observedAfter} AND created_at >= #{createdAfter} AND ( seller_last_seen IS NULL OR seller_last_seen >= #{sellerAfter} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM wf_riven_sample WHERE weapon_slug=#{weapon} AND
AND JSON_CONTAINS(attributes_json, #{attributes})
AND ((JSON_LENGTH(attributes_json)=#{attributeCount} AND JSON_CONTAINS(attributes_json, '{"positive":false}')=0) OR (JSON_LENGTH(attributes_json)=#{attributeCount}+1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(attributes_json, '{"positive":false}')=1))
AND JSON_LENGTH(attributes_json)=#{attributeCount}
AND mod_rank=#{rank} ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, auction_id LIMIT 500
